verdict.rationale: LocalAI's homepage lists 'vision' among the modalities its runtime serves, a first-party claim that it supports vision models. Nothing in the pack documents how images are passed alongside text or which vision-language models or backends are supported. missing for 10: dedicated vision/VLM documentation, an image-plus-text input API example (e.g. OpenAI-style image content in chat), a list of supported vision-language models or backends, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run vision-language models that understand images alongside text

citations.quote: Text, voice, vision, images, video, 3D and agents, from one open runtime.
